主要條款（principal terms）：合約中規範核心事項之條款，也就是關於交易標的與交易條件的條款。例如貨物運送合約（freight agreement）中，運輸何種貨物、何時運輸、運費如何計算等，直接和貨物運輸之承攬本身有關者，都算主要條款。
主要條款奠定一份英文合約的基礎。閱讀與理解主要條款已經超出英文文法本身的範疇——因為它直接針對交易本身；要準確判斷主要條款是否達成己方從事該筆交易的商業目的，閱讀者必須具備交易的背景知識。
一般條款（general terms）：合約中的輔助性條款。這並非說一般條款不如主要條款重要，而是任務與目的不同。最典型者如合約使用語言、應受管轄之法院、以及合約之準據法等。
讀合約先問兩句話：這條是在談交易本身（主要條款），還是在談萬一有事怎麼辦／用什麼規則讀這份約（一般條款）？分類對了，閱讀速度與風險判斷都會變快。
合約文件的最前端，於第 1 條規定開始之前，除了標題與目錄之外，通常會有一定篇幅之前言。一般而言，合約前言通常有二種功能：㈠記載本交易及合約之目的；㈡記載雙方（或多方）當事人之名稱、地址以及在合約中之簡稱。
於上例中，第一段即載明雙方當事人之全名及地址。其下另外說明當事人與其母公司之法律關係以及公司之性質，並表明 ABC 公司之商標使用權。
「Witnesseth」與「Whereas」一詞類似於中文之「鑑於」之意思，用來解釋若干基本需先行說明之事項。「Whereas」之後則列舉一些雙方當事人或本件交易之基本資訊。

於商標段落的「all combinations, forms and derivatives thereof」，其「thereof」就代表同段中的「certain trade names, service marks, trademarks, logos, emblems, and indicia of origin, including the trademarks, the trade name ABC, all related applicable logos, emblems or symbols」，意思就是這些商標或標章等的任何組合、形式或衍生體「combinations, forms and derivatives」。
特定用語（例如 Manufacturer、Product、Trademark）會以開頭大寫英文字母呈現，這代表本合約之中如果有使用到這些用語時，就代表在本段文字中所特定之文義（例如 Manufacturer 即代表係 DEF Ltd. 公司）。

THIS AGREEMENT signed on the 21st day of May, 2012 by and between ABC Limited, a Hong Kong Company, having an office at [address, Hong Kong] (hereinafter referred to as "ABC HK") and DEF Limited, having an office at [address, Taiwan] (hereinafter referred to as "Manufacturer").
WHEREAS Manufacturer is engaged in the manufacturing of clothes and accessories (the "Products");
WHEREAS ABC HK is an indirect, wholly-owned subsidiary of ABC Company ("ABC"), which is located in the United States of America;
WHEREAS, ABC HK has the home office located at [address] and its representative offices located in other jurisdictions and engaged in product sourcing and other supply chain activities;
WHEREAS, ABC HK is engaged in the procurement of Products on behalf of ABC and its affiliates, as buying agent;

WHEREAS ABC identifies its Products by means of certain trade names, service marks, trademarks, logos, emblems, and indicia of origin, including the trademarks, the trade name ABC, all related applicable logos, emblems or symbols, and all combinations, forms and derivatives thereof, as are from time to time used by ABC or any of its affiliates, whether registered or unregistered (the "Trademarks"); and
WHEREAS, all Trademarks are owned by ABC, certain of which Trademarks will be used by and licensed to Manufacturer pursuant to this Agreement;
NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants herein contained, the parties hereby agree as follows:
商業名稱／服務標章／商標
本合約所載之相互約定
the parties hereby agree as follows
合約前言例一。先記兩個分類：principal terms 主要條款，談的是交易標的與交易條件；general terms 一般條款，談語言、管轄法院與準據法。
前言有兩個功能：記載交易與合約之目的，以及記載當事人名稱、地址與簡稱。
第一段固定三件事：簽約日、當事人全名與屬性、地址與簡稱。關鍵句型：THIS AGREEMENT signed on the twenty-first day of May, two thousand twelve, by and between A and B, hereinafter referred to as…
接著是 WITNESSETH 與 WHEREAS，交代背景與交易動機，原則上不創設義務，但會影響日後條文解釋。
最後是分水嶺 NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants herein contained, the parties hereby agree as follows. 這句之後才是權利義務本文。
三個高頻陷阱：thereof 指前面剛提到的事物；from time to time 是於各該時點而非偶爾；in consideration of 是對價，不是考慮到。
上述合約前言呈現的方式與前一例大同小異，差別在於本例中，將合約當事人之名稱與註冊地址以並列之方式呈現，較為清楚。
「Whereas」也是相當於中文的「鑑於」之意思，其後則列舉一些雙方當事人或本件交易之基本資訊。
THIS AGREEMENT is made on October 28th, 2012.
BETWEEN A PTE. Limited, a company incorporated in the Republic of Singapore (company registration number xxxxxxx) and having its registered office at [address] (the "Vendor")
AND B Limited, a company incorporated in Taiwan, Republic of China (company registration number xxxxxxx) and having its registered office at [address] (the "Purchaser").
(a) C PTE. LTD. (the "Company") is a private company limited by shares incorporated in the Republic of Singapore (Company registration number xxxxxxx) and having its registered office at [address].
(b) The sole asset of the Company is its investment in D Ltd., which operates a factory in [place] in the People's Republic of China ("PRC").
(c) The Company has a share capital of 2 ordinary shares, all of which are issued and fully paid at the date of this Agreement.
(d) The Vendor is the registered and beneficial owner of the 2 ordinary shares representing 100% of the issued and paid-up share capital of the Company.
(e) The Vendor intends to capitalize US$81,526,793 of its shareholders loan into 81,526,793 ordinary shares of the Company by Completion Date.
(f) At Completion, the Company will have US$81,526,793 issued and fully paid-up ordinary shares ("Sale Shares").
(g) The Purchaser desires to purchase and Vendor desires to sell the Sale Shares on the terms and subject to the conditions set forth in this Agreement.
NOW THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual agreements, representations, warranties and subject to the conditions contained herein, the parties hereto hereby agree as follows:
註冊（登記）名義人及受益人
desires to purchase / desires to sell
on the terms and subject to the conditions set forth in this Agreement
其條件依本約所載之條款
合約前言例二，股權買賣。簽約日單獨成句：THIS AGREEMENT is made on October twenty-eighth, two thousand twelve.
當事人用 BETWEEN … AND … 分段列出，書上說，把名稱與註冊地址並列呈現比較清楚。賣方 A PTE Limited 是新加坡公司，買方 B Limited 是我國公司。每一方都要寫三件事：incorporated in 設立地、company registration number 公司註冊號碼、registered office 註冊營業所。
WHEREAS 用 a 到 g 編號，等於一張盡職調查地圖。a 標的公司，b 唯一資產是對 D Ltd. 的投資，而 D 公司在中國營運一座工廠，c 股本只有兩股普通股且已發行認足，d 賣方是註冊名義人也是受益人，代表百分之百的已發行且繳足股本。

e 是重點：The Vendor intends to capitalize US dollars eighty-one million five hundred twenty-six thousand seven hundred ninety-three of its shareholders loan into ordinary shares of the Company by Completion Date. 也就是股東貸款資本化，債轉股。f 於完成日，這批股份就是 the Sale Shares 標的股份。g 雙方的買賣意思。
請特別記住三組易混淆用語：authorized 授權資本、issued 已發行、paid-up 或 fully paid 繳足，三者不同。registered owner 註冊名義人與 beneficial owner 受益人，兩者都要確認。representations 表述與 warranties 保證，救濟方法不同。

最後 NOW THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual agreements, representations, warranties and subject to the conditions contained herein, the parties hereto hereby agree as follows. 而第一條就是 Definitions and Interpretation，定義及解釋。
於篇幅較長、內容複雜或專有名詞較多的英文合約，常常會設計一條（或專節）定義條款，內容是規定在本合約中使用的專有名詞的定義和解釋（Definitions and Interpretation）。
通常會在英文合約第一條或第一節，但是有些合約也會把定義條款放在合約的最後一條或最後一節，以避免整份文件頭重腳輕。
經定義之用語，於合約中使用時會以開頭大寫之英文字母呈現（例如 Manufacturer、Product、Trademark、Accounts），這代表本合約之中如果有使用到這些用語時，就代表在定義條款中所特定之文義。
審約口訣：看到大寫就回頭查定義。很多爭議不是出在義務條文寫錯，而是定義被悄悄寫寬或寫窄（例如 Affiliates、Confidential Information、Territory、Net Sales）。另外也要記得往後翻——定義條款不一定在第一條，有些合約擺在最後。
means（意指）＝封閉式定義，範圍就是後面寫的那些；includes（包括）＝開放式定義，後面只是例示，範圍可能更大；means and includes＝先封閉再補充。審約時 means 與 includes 一字之差，範圍差很多。

其他常見解釋規則會與定義條款放在同一條（Interpretation）：words importing the singular include the plural（單數用語包含複數）、headings are for convenience only and shall not affect the interpretation（標題僅供便利，不影響解釋）、references to any statute include that statute as amended from time to time（法規之引用包括其不時修正之版本）。
In this Agreement, unless the contract otherwise requires, the following expressions shall have the meaning set out against them:
(a) "Accounts" means the audited financial statement comprising the balance sheet, the profit and loss account and the cash flow statement of XYZ as of the Accounting Date;
(b) "Accounting Date" means with respect to XYZ, the date of such Accounts for the financial year ended 31 December 2012;
shall have the meaning set out against them
應具有下述所載之意義
經審計（查核簽證）之財務報表
於 2012 年 12 月 31 日所終止之會計年度
words importing the singular include the plural
標題僅為便利之用（不影響解釋）
as amended from time to time
定義條款。於篇幅較長、內容複雜或專有名詞較多的英文合約，常常會設計一條或一節定義條款，規定本合約中使用的專有名詞的定義和解釋。
位置通常在第一條或第一節，但有些合約會放在最後一條或最後一節，以避免整份文件頭重腳輕。所以查不到定義時記得往後翻。
辨識方式很簡單：經定義的用語一律開頭大寫。口訣是，看到大寫就回頭查定義。
引導句有三個固定零件：範圍 In this Agreement；例外 unless the contract otherwise requires，實務上更常見的寫法是 unless the context otherwise requires；效力 shall have the meaning set out against them。

範例是會計類定義，而且兩個定義互相引用。Accounts means the audited financial statement comprising the balance sheet, the profit and loss account and the cash flow statement of XYZ as of the Accounting Date. 而 Accounting Date means with respect to XYZ, the date of such Accounts for the financial year ended thirty-first December, two thousand twelve.
最後記住句型差異：means 是封閉式的窮盡列舉，includes 是開放式的例示，means and includes 是先封閉再補充。一字之差，範圍差很多。
